metaTitle: Service categories | Admin | PR Per Hour
metaDescription: Manage service categories for PR Per Hour administrators.
title: Service categories
lead: Create, edit, activate, and soft-delete service categories used across the catalog.
limitationBody: The admin list returns active and inactive categories only. Soft-deleted rows are excluded by the API, so there is no browsable restore list. After you delete a category, use Undo restore while the success notice is visible. Restoring an older deleted category requires its numeric id from another source.
name: Name
isActiveCreateHint: Inactive categories stay hidden from the public catalog.
isActiveEditHint: Status changes use the dedicated status endpoint when you save.
slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only (for example strategic-communication).
createDescription: Add a service category. Slug must be unique.
editDescription: Update name, slug, description, or active status.
deleteDescription: Soft-delete “{{name}}”? It will leave public and admin lists until restored.
softDeleteNote: This is a soft delete. The category is hidden, not permanently removed. There is no force-delete action in this UI.
emptyDescription: No categories match these filters, or none exist yet. Create a category to get started.
listErrorDescription: The category list could not be loaded. Try again.
validationNameMax: Name must be 255 characters or fewer.
validationSlugMax: Slug must be 255 characters or fewer.
validationSlugFormat: Use lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only.
errorUnauthorized: Your session is not authorized. Sign in again as an admin.
errorForbidden: You do not have permission to manage categories.
errorConflict: This category conflicts with an existing record (for example a duplicate slug).
errorRateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
errorNetwork: Network error. Check your connection and try again.
errorServer: The server could not complete this request. Try again later.
